endpoint_actual_decision_sensitivity.interpretation: fixed-other-state scalar classification sensitivity; compare actual later S120 shifts to this margin, not only its 0.2 percent allowance

forecast_not_observation.basis: Frozen N16/24/32 power-law continuation, reviewed before N36. Forecasts are never substituted for native reactions.
forecast_not_observation.threshold_assumption: Uses abs(endpoint F36) as the series maximum for this forecast; actual gate must use max across all 61 native states.
forecast_not_observation.warning: The 0.636 microN endpoint decision sensitivity is about 114 times smaller than the original 0.2 percent temporal allowance. Passing that temporal tolerance alone would not prove this fragile spatial classification invariant; report actual observed step changes against the decision margin without retroactively relaxing any gate.

interpretation: conditional two-limit model-sensitivity envelope; not a rigorous error bound or continuum certification
